svg.aria-label: Cache-miss heat maps of the turned floor: row-major texels miss 7445 times, tiled texels 2112
svg.text: The floor turned a quarter turn
Texture cache misses per 4 x 2 block of pixels
Row after row misses 3.5 times as often: a
block of pixels reads four texel rows, four cache lines,
and each line is gone before the warps two rows up need
it. The grey squares under the colours are the floor
itself, drawn faint. The darker a block, the more it missed:
